overview: YourChain is a YouTube-like video platform built 100% on-chain on the Internet Computer, with Internet Identity auth, chunked/resumable video uploads, backend-paginated feeds, subscriptions, and watch pages.
features: Sign in with Internet Identity and manage a public channel profile
Upload and publish videos up to 1 GB with chunked, resumable uploads and progress
Browse a global feed and a subscriptions feed with infinite scroll
Watch videos with streaming playback on a dedicated watch page
Subscribe and unsubscribe to channels and receive notifications
Responsive YouTube-like UI with YourChain branding
